mapper.select: SELECT pl.id AS location_id, pl.name, pl.description, pl.visual_prompt FROM scenes s JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = s.chapter_id JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = ch.story_version_id LEFT JOIN project_locations pl ON pl.id = s.project_location_id WHERE s.id = #{sceneId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND sv.project_id = #{projectId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pc.id AS assignment_id, c.id AS character_id, c.canonical_name, canon.version_number, canon.visual_prompt, appearance.appearance_prompt, appearance.age_state, appearance.hairstyle, appearance.injury, appearance.wardrobe_context, NULL::varchar AS beat_role FROM scene_characters sc JOIN scenes s ON s.id = sc.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = s.chapter_id JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = ch.story_version_id JOIN project_characters pc ON pc.id = sc.project_character_id JOIN characters c ON c.id = pc.character_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cv.id, cv.version_number, cv.visual_prompt FROM character_versions cv WHERE cv.character_id = c.id AND ( cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id OR ( pc.pinned_character_version_id IS NULL AND cv.status = 'LOCKED' ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cv.version_number DESC, cv.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) canon ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT scs.timeline_key FROM chapter_continuity_plans ccp JOIN scene_continuity_states scs ON scs.plan_id = ccp.id AND scs.scene_id = s.id WHERE ccp.project_id = #{projectId} AND ccp.chapter_id = ch.id AND ccp.storyboard_revision_id = s.storyboard_revision_id AND ccp.source_hash = ch.source_hash ORDER BY ccp.revision DESC LIMIT 1 ) continuity_scope ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ca.appearance_prompt, ca.age_state, ca.hairstyle, ca.injury, ca.wardrobe_context FROM character_appearances ca WHERE ca.character_id = c.id AND (ca.project_id = pc.project_id OR ca.project_id IS NULL) AND ( (continuity_scope.timeline_key IS NOT NULL AND ca.timeline_key = continuity_scope.timeline_key) OR (continuity_scope.timeline_key IS NULL AND ca.timeline_key = CONCAT('chapter:', ch.id::text)) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ca.project_id = pc.project_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ca.updated_at DESC, ca.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) appearance ON TRUE WHERE sc.scene_id = #{sceneId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND sv.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sc.order_index, pc.id

SELECT pc.id AS assignment_id, ma.id AS asset_id, ref.reference_role AS role, ref.priority, ma.storage_key, COALESCE(ma.detected_content_type, ma.content_type) AS content_type, ma.sha256 FROM scene_characters sc JOIN scenes s ON s.id = sc.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = s.chapter_id JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = ch.story_version_id JOIN project_characters pc ON pc.id = sc.project_character_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = pc.project_id JOIN characters c ON c.id = pc.character_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cv.id FROM character_versions cv WHERE cv.character_id = c.id AND ( cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id OR ( pc.pinned_character_version_id IS NULL AND cv.status = 'LOCKED' ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cv.version_number DESC, cv.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) canon ON TRUE JOIN character_version_reference_assets ref ON ref.character_version_id = canon.id JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.id = ref.media_asset_id AND ma.account_id = p.owner_id AND ma.asset_type = 'IMAGE' AND ma.status = 'READY' AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sc.scene_id = #{sceneId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND sv.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sc.order_index, pc.id, ref.priority, ma.id

SELECT pl.id AS location_id, pl.name, pl.description, pl.visual_prompt FROM visual_beats vb JOIN scenes s ON s.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = s.chapter_id JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = ch.story_version_id LEFT JOIN project_locations pl ON pl.id = s.project_location_id WHERE vb.id = #{visualBeatId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND sv.project_id = #{projectId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pc.id AS assignment_id, c.id AS character_id, c.canonical_name, canon.version_number, canon.visual_prompt, appearance.appearance_prompt, appearance.age_state, appearance.hairstyle, appearance.injury, appearance.wardrobe_context, COALESCE(vbc.role, 'SECONDARY') AS beat_role FROM visual_beats vb JOIN scenes s ON s.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = s.chapter_id JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = ch.story_version_id JOIN scene_characters sc ON sc.scene_id = s.id JOIN project_characters pc ON pc.id = sc.project_character_id JOIN characters c ON c.id = pc.character_id LEFT JOIN visual_beat_characters vbc ON vbc.visual_beat_id = vb.id AND vbc.project_character_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cv.id, cv.version_number, cv.visual_prompt FROM character_versions cv WHERE cv.character_id = c.id AND ( cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id OR ( pc.pinned_character_version_id IS NULL AND cv.status = 'LOCKED' ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cv.version_number DESC, cv.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) canon ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT scs.timeline_key FROM chapter_continuity_plans ccp JOIN scene_continuity_states scs ON scs.plan_id = ccp.id AND scs.scene_id = s.id WHERE ccp.project_id = #{projectId} AND ccp.chapter_id = ch.id AND ccp.storyboard_revision_id = s.storyboard_revision_id AND ccp.source_hash = ch.source_hash ORDER BY ccp.revision DESC LIMIT 1 ) continuity_scope ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ca.appearance_prompt, ca.age_state, ca.hairstyle, ca.injury, ca.wardrobe_context FROM character_appearances ca WHERE ca.character_id = c.id AND (ca.project_id = pc.project_id OR ca.project_id IS NULL) AND ( (continuity_scope.timeline_key IS NOT NULL AND ca.timeline_key = continuity_scope.timeline_key) OR (continuity_scope.timeline_key IS NULL AND ca.timeline_key = CONCAT('chapter:', ch.id::text)) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ca.project_id = pc.project_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ca.updated_at DESC, ca.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) appearance ON TRUE WHERE vb.id = #{visualBeatId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND sv.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM visual_beat_characters any_vbc WHERE any_vbc.visual_beat_id = vb.id ) OR vbc.visual_beat_id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY CASE COALESCE(vbc.role, 'SECONDARY') WHEN 'PRIMARY' THEN 0 WHEN 'SECONDARY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, sc.order_index, pc.id

SELECT pc.id AS assignment_id, ma.id AS asset_id, ref.reference_role AS role, ref.priority, ma.storage_key, COALESCE(ma.detected_content_type, ma.content_type) AS content_type, ma.sha256 FROM visual_beats vb JOIN scenes s ON s.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = s.chapter_id JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = ch.story_version_id JOIN scene_characters sc ON sc.scene_id = s.id JOIN project_characters pc ON pc.id = sc.project_character_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = pc.project_id JOIN characters c ON c.id = pc.character_id LEFT JOIN visual_beat_characters vbc ON vbc.visual_beat_id = vb.id AND vbc.project_character_id = pc.id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cv.id FROM character_versions cv WHERE cv.character_id = c.id AND ( cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id OR ( pc.pinned_character_version_id IS NULL AND cv.status = 'LOCKED' ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cv.version_number DESC, cv.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) canon ON TRUE JOIN character_version_reference_assets ref ON ref.character_version_id = canon.id JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.id = ref.media_asset_id AND ma.account_id = p.owner_id AND ma.asset_type = 'IMAGE' AND ma.status = 'READY' AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE vb.id = #{visualBeatId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND sv.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM visual_beat_characters any_vbc WHERE any_vbc.visual_beat_id = vb.id ) OR vbc.visual_beat_id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY CASE COALESCE(vbc.role, 'SECONDARY') WHEN 'PRIMARY' THEN 0 WHEN 'SECONDARY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, sc.order_index, pc.id, ref.priority, ma.id
